channel.title: Blog · Melbees
channel.description: Science, education, culture, puzzles, games and music. Everything we post on social media, explained at an easy pace.

item.title: Do bees understand zero? What the science found
item.description: A 2018 study in Science found that honey bees treat zero as less than one. See how the test worked, what it shows and what it does not.

item.title: Day of the Dead (Día de Muertos): what it is, when it is and what the ofrenda means
item.description: What is Day of the Dead? Día de Muertos, November 1 and 2 in Mexico: the ofrenda, the word cempasúchil, the calaveritas and what UNESCO recognized in 2008.

item.title: GTA VI: 100 hours or 5 minutes a day? How to fit games into your routine
item.description: A 100-hour game and a 5-minute daily one can live side by side. Here is how to build the routine and why the Melbees Daily Challenge fits into it.

item.title: GTA VI with friends: games to play together, in pairs and as a team
item.description: Want something light to play with friends after GTA VI? See how the Melbees Duel and Co-op modes work, right in the browser, and how to invite someone.

item.title: GTA VI memes: sick day, internship, 30 fps and the heist at checkout
item.description: The GTA VI memes that became Melbees videos: calling in sick, an internship included, 30 fps, checkout, single-player and more. What each joke means.

item.title: GTA VI: what to play while it downloads (or while you wait your turn)
item.description: While GTA VI downloads, installs or waits for your turn on the couch, a 5-minute game warms up your brain. Here is how the Melbees Daily Challenge works.

item.title: GTA VI: why was the wait so long and the hype so big?
item.description: Why did the wait for GTA VI stir so many people? A look at what makes anticipation huge, and how to make waiting worth it with a small daily game.

item.title: Where does Halloween come from? Samhain, the name and the pumpkin
item.description: Where does Halloween come from? From the Celtic festival of Samhain to the name, the turnip lanterns, the pumpkin and the oldest printed trick or treat.

item.title: Mel's Karaoke: how we make the songs and how to study with them
item.description: See how a Mel's Karaoke is made, from the rhyme to a code-played melody and a Remotion video, and how to use the songs to learn words and English.

item.title: How to read the Pollen numbers in Melbees: a beginner's guide
item.description: Learn how to read the Pollen numbers in Melbees, what zero means, how to match or discard a letter, and try a short logic exercise with the answer.

item.title: Any%, 100% and glitchless: why one game has several world records
item.description: Hollow Knight has a 4:29 record and a 26:38 record, both world records. Here's what Any%, 100% and glitchless mean, with real speedrun.com times.

item.title: Do GTA games have speedruns? The 5 old ones, board by board
item.description: GTA III, Vice City, San Andreas, IV and V all have speedruns on speedrun.com. Here are the categories, the records and how many runners each board has today.

item.title: Does GTA VI have a speedrun? What speedrun.com shows on day three
item.description: GTA VI has a speedrun.com page, but no categories and no runs on day three. Here's what's there and how long other big releases took.

item.title: Portal 2 on the couch with my daughter, and a record that deserves a second look
item.description: Melby Dev on playing Portal 2 co-op on the couch with his daughter, how it relates to The Secret of Bees, and a catch in a speedrun record.

item.title: I've never played Minecraft, but I fell down the RNG hole
item.description: My daughter plays Minecraft, I don't. A Summoning Salt video and a Veritasium one pulled me into RNG: in a computer's generator, the same seed replays the same sequence.

item.title: Will the Ocarina speedrun tricks survive the remake?
item.description: The Ocarina of Time remake is out on Switch 2. I wanted to know if the 1998 original's speedrun tricks still work in it. What we know and what's still missing.
